related.title: 浮式風機動態電纜設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「輸出海纜的充電電流」與「海上安裝的天氣窗」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；浮式風機動態電纜設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Charging current of export cables" and "Weather windows for offshore installation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Floating Wind Dynamic Cable Design must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦海纜上岸的最後一公里：水平導向鑽掘、拉纜張力、深埋段的散熱瓶頸與故障定位；浮式風機動態電纜設計則以隨著浮台一起動的電纜：惰波形構型、浮力模組、彎曲應變與波浪疲勞為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the last kilometre where a sea cable comes ashore: horizontal directional drilling, pulling tension, the thermal bottleneck of deep burial and fault location; Floating Wind Dynamic Cable Design centres on A cable that moves with the floater: the lazy-wave shape, buoyancy modules, bending strain and wave fatigue, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「陣列電纜電流與串接數」的模型移到浮式風機動態電纜設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「二十五年的波浪循環數」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Array-cable current and string size" to Floating Wind Dynamic Cable Design, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Wave cycles in twenty-five years", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「輸出海纜的充電電流」與「海上安裝的天氣窗」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；浮式風機動態電纜設計的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Charging current of export cables" and "Weather windows for offshore installation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Floating Wind Dynamic Cable Design must be respecified.

related.title: 霍恩西離岸風電場
related.transfer: 可遷移「輸出海纜的充電電流」與「海上安裝的天氣窗」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩西離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Charging current of export cables" and "Weather windows for offshore installation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦海纜上岸的最後一公里：水平導向鑽掘、拉纜張力、深埋段的散熱瓶頸與故障定位；霍恩西離岸風電場則以遠離岸 120 公里的交流併網：中途無功補償、2019 年大停電的教訓與遠海運維為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on the last kilometre where a sea cable comes ashore: horizontal directional drilling, pulling tension, the thermal bottleneck of deep burial and fault location; Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm centres on AC connection 120 km from shore: mid-route reactive compensation, lessons of the 2019 blackout and far-offshore maintenance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「年發電量與容量因數」與「年發電量與容量因數」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「陣列電纜電流與串接數」的模型移到霍恩西離岸風電場，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「中途無功補償站」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "Annual energy and capacity factor" and "Annual energy and capacity factor".
Move the model of "Array-cable current and string size" to Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "The mid-route reactive compensation station", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「輸出海纜的充電電流」與「海上安裝的天氣窗」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；霍恩西離岸風電場的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Charging current of export cables" and "Weather windows for offshore installation" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of Hornsea Offshore Wind Farm must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 離岸風電海纜登陸工程
history.titleEn: Offshore Wind Export Cable Landfall Engineering
history.text: 1990 年首批離岸風場以明挖方式上岸；2005 年水平導向鑽掘成為登陸的主要工法；2015 年220 kV 交流海纜成為大型風場的標準；2020 年±525 kV 直流海纜開始部署。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 1990: The first offshore wind farms came ashore by open-cut trench. 2005: Horizontal directional drilling became the main landfall method. 2015: 220 kV AC cable became standard for large farms. 2020: ±525 kV DC cable began to be deployed. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
